facts.fact: The foreword thanks UNDP, the African Development Bank and other partners for their role in the technical workshops and the national workshop to validate the strategy document; the version-1.2 text dated 11 June 2024 names no adopting decree or launch act, and calls itself the strategy of the Transition Government under Prime Minister Bernard Goumou.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The full strategy text, version 1.2 dated 11 June 2024, is published as a PDF on the site of the state digitalisation agency ANDE, issued by the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy (MPTEN) with ANDE.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The strategy is titled 2023-2027 and sets its vision and 14 result indicators against 2022 references for a 2027 horizon, as 'Guinée Digitale 2027'.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The strategy sets a roadmap of 245 initiatives under 41 orientations and six axes (57, 20, 66, 24, 28 and 50 initiatives on its overview slide), each with a responsible body, a cost in thousand USD and a duration, and states a total investment of GNF 3,649,955,743 million (USD 422,152 thousand) on that slide.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The portfolio budget summary by axis totals 245 projects at GNF 15,109,663,140 thousand (USD 1,747,590 thousand), a figure that does not match the USD 422,152 thousand total stated in the vision section; axis 3 infrastructure alone is USD 1,203,425 thousand and the summary counts 57, 20, 24, 61, 29 and 54 projects by axis.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The strategy names MPTEN as lead ministry (ministère chef de file) responsible for drafting, coordinating, implementing and evaluating it, with ANDE, ANSSI, GUILAB, SOGEB, the data protection authority, Guinée Télécoms, ARPT, ANSUTEN and La Poste as implementing bodies, and names the Comité National de Digitalisation de l'État (CNDE) as its steering body, to be set up and made operational (initiative 1.2.1, over 500 thousand USD, 12 months), chaired by the Prime Minister or the Secretary General of the Government.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The CNDE is to arbitrate, give directives and review progress, and to include the ministers for digital, economy and finance and the priority sectors, the Observatoire National du Numérique and private-sector representatives; below it the strategy plans a technical monitoring committee under MPTEN, a coordination and monitoring unit within MPTEN, six working groups (one per axis), project committees per ministry, a steering dashboard (1.2.5, 100 thousand USD, 3 months) and the Observatory (1.2.6, 1,200 thousand USD, 48 months).
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The financing table of the portfolio puts the State (Etat) share at USD 209,711 thousand, 12 percent of the USD 1,747,590 thousand total; the text adds that annual national-budget allocations are often well below forecasts and can be frozen, and states no budget line or appropriation for the strategy.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027

facts.fact: The financing table puts development partners (PTF) at USD 1,048,554 thousand, 60 percent of the USD 1,747,590 thousand total, alongside PPP at USD 349,518 thousand (20 percent) and private sources at USD 139,807 thousand (8 percent); the text describes the route as ministry-prepared requests signed by the finance minister to World Bank, African Development Bank, EU, AFD and other funders, and names no signed financing agreement.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de digitalisation de l'État et de développement de l'économie numérique 2023-2027
